headline: 亞歷山大道歉舊短劇
context: 《歡樂單身派對》（Seinfeld）演員傑森．亞歷山大（Jason Alexander），為2012年一支喜劇短劇公開道歉。短劇中他曾將手機貼近寇特妮．史托登（Courtney Stodden）胸部，當時她只有17歲，亞歷山大是該短劇的編劇之一。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Alexander rubs a phone against the actress’s breasts in the Funny or Die comedy sketch, which was published when she was 17.
sources.title: Jason Alexander Apologizes for 2012 Sketch With Teenage Courtney Stodden

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The actor, who is one of the writers credited for the Funny or Die sketch, said he was ‘deeply sorry for any harm or distress’ caused by the 2012 skit Seinfeld star Jason Alexander has apologized to the model Courtney Stodden for a decade-old comedy sketch in which he rubbed a mobile phone on her breasts when she was 17, saying, “It was inappropriate and I truly regret it”. Stodden made international headlines in 2011 when she married her ex-husband, The Green Mile actor Doug Hutchison, when she was 16 and he was 51. Though she was a minor, the marriage was legal due to her parents giving their permission. Stodden and Hutchison divorced in 2020. Continue reading...
sources.title: Seinfeld’s Jason Alexander apologizes to Courtney Stodden for ‘inappropriate’ sketch made when she was a teenager

亞歷山大道歉舊短劇

《歡樂單身派對》（Seinfeld）演員傑森．亞歷山大（Jason Alexander），為2012年一支Funny or Die喜劇短劇公開道歉。短劇中他曾將手機貼近寇特妮．史托登（Courtney Stodden）胸部，當時她只有17歲，亞歷山大是該短劇的編劇之一。他說：「對造成的任何傷害或困擾，我深感抱歉。」

—— 本則來自 The New York Times、The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 23 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
